selection_reasoning: The task 'find cornflower' is a straightforward observation/navigation task that requires the agent to locate a cornflower in the Minecraft world. It is easily verifiable (the agent needs to have a cornflower in view or reach it), does not require deep Minecraft domain knowledge, and can be set up in a scene with clear visual landmarks. As a single atomic task, no dependency edges are needed.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the cornflower (placed at spawn-relative [5, 0, 3]) and face toward it. max_distance=5 requires the player to walk at least ~1 block from spawn toward the flower (since spawn is ~5.83 blocks away), preventing trivial completion by just turning in place. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the cornflower, modeling 'the player has found and is observing the blue flower'.

scene_description: A flat grass meadow with several flowers scattered around. A cornflower (blue flower) is placed at ~5 ~0 ~3 from spawn. Other flowers (dandelion, poppy) and grass serve as distractors. A single oak log post acts as a landmark. The player must navigate the meadow and locate the cornflower.
task_text: Find the cornflower (a small blue flower) in the meadow.
design_notes: The cornflower is placed 5 blocks east and 3 blocks south of spawn on a flat grass meadow (~5, ~0, ~3 relative to spawn). Distractor flowers (dandelion at ~3,~0,~5 and poppy at ~7,~0,~1) add visual complexity. A single oak log at ~-3,~0,~-3 serves as a landmark. The flat terrain ensures unobstructed navigation. The agent successfully found the cornflower within 10 steps during preview. The task is 'find cornflower' meaning the player needs to get close enough to see/reach it.
